|Something with short circuit test. Connect a wattemeter to measure power loss. Explain the principle of reflective current on primary.

|We know that cealing fan speed is regulated by rotating regulator knob. When you remove the fan blades then you are unable to do so. Why ? 

|How can you charge a capcitor with 220V dc voltage source ?.. Value of R required for charging, calculate power loss without integrating

|If we are applying axial strain, what type of arrangment is made in metal foil strain gauge to correct the error due to transverse strain?

|A DC voltage source and a circuit is given. What configuration should be used such that irrespective of the polarity of the battery the circuit should work fine.

|Draw the V-I characteristics of a practical diode and write down expressions for calculating its static and dynamic resistance.

|At which point on the V-I characteristic curve is the static resistance equal to the dynamic resistance.

|Draw the circuit which you would use for measuring the V and I values for plotting the V-I characteristics curve of the practical diode. You are provided with a 5V battery as your voltage source.

|You are given a 3.3V Zener diode which is connected with a random signal generator located to its left with a 1k resistance connecting one lead of the signal generator to the cathode of the diode, and anode of the diode is connected directly to the other lead of the signal generator. The signal generator generates discrete time random valued voltage pulses following a normal distribution with mean of 0V and standard deviation of 3 V. That would be the pdf of the signals sensed across the leads of the Zener diode.

|When speaking your frequency of signals range in 80-800 Hz and I am sampling your speech at 1kHz, what will I hear if I playback the recorded signal.

|Given a transfer function (s+a)/((s+b)*(s+c))..where b>0,c>0 and for case of a>0 and a<0 comment on phase margin,stability

|Can you make a potential divider with output voltage more than input voltage using a rheostat and a voltage source?

|Draw Sinx/x and which filter has this impulse response?Is it feasible?If not then how to make it feasible?

|If I switch supply terminals of a DC shunt motor, will it rotate in opposite direction? Justify your answer.

|draw a bridge circuit diagram with 2 diodes and 2 thyristor for 1 phase AC to DC converter. Show input and output signals

|What would you use to measure petrol at a petrol pump? ( would you use volumetric flow meter or mass flow meter)

|Do not draw the simple diagram, rather the one where current in coils is shown via dot and cross convention

|you have a black box containing resistance and capacitance, you dunno the values.. how will u find out in lab..

|u design a FIR filter in lab of 5th order and cutoff frequency is 500Hz.and sampling rate is 5Hz. but theoretically, u observe that the sampling frequency is 3KHz. What is the observed cutoff frequency

|Gave the T.F of a plant and a controller with unity negative feedback and asked about the stability of the individual components as well as the entire system

|How do you find the values of unknown R and C using a oscilloscope and a battery(multimeter not avbl)

|Draw the diagram of a flapper nozzle system, it's characteristic plot and derive its expression, hence the gain value

|You have a voltage signal lagging the current by some angle theta, develope a digital system to measure the power accurately

|Given a system G(s)=1/((s+2)(s-2)), would it be stable? If it might be stable given some conditions, what could they be? (specify the ROC)

|Draw the frequency response of low pass filter. If one forgets the negative frequency part, why is the filter non realisable?
